title.vi: Xây dựng Audio Platform: instant Play, offline intent và trusted reports
title.en: Building an Audio Platform: instant playback, offline intent and trusted reports

summary.vi: 11 giai đoạn kiến trúc và ba lab: startup critical path, playlist anchors/replay và qualified-play reporting; giữ media, rights và evidence đúng authority.
summary.en: Eleven architecture stages and three labs explore startup critical paths, playlist anchors/replay and qualified-play reports under separate media, rights and evidence authority.

takeaways.vi: Startup là critical path; valid rights và bytes đều phải ready trước output.
takeaways.en: Startup follows dependencies; rights and bytes must both be ready.

takeaways.vi: Offline capability có bounded revocation/check-in window; encryption không là authorization.
takeaways.en: Offline rights have bounded check-ins/revocation; encryption is not authorization.

takeaways.vi: Playlist log không tự merge intent; entries/anchors/context và ownership cần protocol.
takeaways.en: Logs do not merge intent automatically; identities, contexts and ownership need protocols.

takeaways.vi: Event dedup khác qualified play và payout evidence; closed reports cần adjustments.
takeaways.en: Transport deduplication differs from qualified plays and payment evidence; closed reports need corrections.

takeaways.vi: Reuse delivery paths, nhưng giữ policies/content types và operational ownership rõ.
takeaways.en: Reuse delivery while preserving content policies and operational ownership.

title.vi: 1. Audio platform: cảm giác instant và evidence đáng tin
title.en: 1. Audio platforms: instant experience and trustworthy evidence

paragraphs.vi: Bài này thiết kế platform kiểu Spotify: music playback, offline downloads, playlist sync, events, discovery, long-form audio và hybrid search. 11 stages dùng public learning themes nhưng là teaching architecture, không inventory production hiện tại. Mục tiêu là hiểu vì sao bytes, rights, user intent và financial/report evidence phải tách authority.
paragraphs.en: This Spotify-style platform covers music, downloads, playlists, events, discovery, long-form audio and hybrid search. Eleven teaching stages explore public architectural themes rather than a current deployment inventory, separating media, rights, intent and evidence.

paragraphs.vi: Historical hybrid client-server/P2P cho desktop cho thấy delivery sources có thể đổi mà product loop vẫn giống nhau. Một measurement cũ gồm cache hits không trở thành SLA hiện tại cho mobile random jumps. Dưới đây mọi số trong labs đều synthetic; rights và reporting policies được đặt rõ, không mô phỏng Spotify DRM hoặc royalty engine.
paragraphs.en: Historical desktop hybrid delivery shows that sources can change while the product loop remains. Old cached measurements do not establish mobile SLAs. Labs use synthetic values and explicit policies rather than implementing Spotify DRM or royalty rules.

items.vi: Bytes immutable, license scoped; cache hit không bypass entitlement.
items.en: Immutable bytes and scoped rights; cache hits never bypass entitlement.

items.vi: Entry/op identity, versions, offline context và device/session ownership.
items.en: Entry/operation identity, versions, offline context and session ownership.

items.vi: Accepted transport khác genuine play, qualification và payable report.
items.en: Accepted transport differs from genuine plays, qualification and payable reports.

title.vi: 2. Một Play có nhiều clocks và ACKs
title.en: 2. Playback has multiple clocks and acknowledgements

paragraphs.vi: Track/content ID, file generation, playlist revision, playback session/owner epoch, event ID và report rule version không thay thế nhau. Chọn generation trước fetch, recheck rights theo capability contract, giữ pending edits/events tới durable ACK. Một stream bytes trả200 không chứng minh đã nghe, còn event ACK không chứng minh event qualify hay payout.
paragraphs.en: Content, file generations, list revisions, session epochs, event identities and rule versions are distinct. Resolve generations, validate rights and retain pending intent until durable acknowledgement. A successful byte response does not prove listening, and event acceptance does not establish qualification/payment.

paragraphs.vi: Playback control multi-device cần current active-session ownership với version/lease. Command stale từ phone cũ không nên pause/seek speaker mới sau handoff; command IDs và expected owner epoch giúp reject. Resume position không luôn max: explicit seek backward/restart khác stale progress update. Define current session authority, sequence/version và reconnect behavior.
paragraphs.en: Multi-device controls need versioned session ownership. Stale phone commands must not control a newly handed-off speaker. Retain command identity/expected epoch and distinguish deliberate backward seeks from stale progress rather than blindly taking maximum position.

title.en: 3. Eleven stages: delivery, correctness and ownership

paragraphs.vi: Mỗi giai đoạn có problem, decision, trade-off, next trigger và exit criteria. Chọn cải tiến dựa evidence: playback tail, event completeness, sync correctness hoặc team operations. Reuse playlist/media primitives khi contract phù hợp, không ép new content types vào cũ nếu entitlement/ordering khác.
paragraphs.en: Each stage states pressure, decisions, costs, triggers and exit criteria. Follow evidence from playback, reporting, synchronization and operations. Reuse primitives when contracts fit without forcing new content into unsuitable entitlement/ordering rules.

title.vi: Bắt đầu playback, rồi tối ưu delivery

description.vi: Thiết kế đầu có native client, catalog, server delivery và optional peer/cache sources. P2P từng là một cách giảm origin bandwidth trên desktop; server cung cấp fast prefix/fallback. Không suy historical measurement thành hiện trạng: mobile constraints, NAT/privacy, upload cost và CDN economics có thể đổi quyết định.
description.en: An initial native client resolves catalogs and uses server delivery with optional peers/caches. Desktop P2P historically reduced origin traffic while servers supplied startup/fallback. Do not treat historical measurements as current architecture; devices, privacy and delivery economics change decisions.

problem.vi: Music phải play nhanh nhưng bandwidth và unreliable sources có cost.
problem.en: Playback must start quickly despite costly bandwidth and unreliable sources.

decision.vi: Separate control metadata khỏi delivery source; verify chunks và keep fallback.
decision.en: Separate control metadata from delivery sources; verify chunks and retain fallback.

tradeoff.vi: Peer discovery/NAT, resource consent và protocol complexity tăng.
tradeoff.en: Peer discovery, NAT, resource consent and protocol complexity add cost.

nextPressure.vi: Skip khiến startup delay quan trọng hơn full download throughput.
nextPressure.en: Skipping makes startup delay more important than total download throughput.

exitCriteria.en: Measure startup/fallback by connection, device and network cohorts.

title.vi: Client cache, warm connection và prefetch budget
title.en: Client caches, warm connections and prefetch budgets

description.vi: Reuse connection, cache valid metadata và prefetch likely next prefix. Tính critical path từ dependencies: license/key và encrypted bytes có thể overlap sau resolve; decode phải chờ cả hai. Prefetch sai lãng phí data/battery và không loại entitlement check. QoE budget xét tails và cold random jumps, không chỉ median cache hits.
description.en: Reuse connections, cache valid metadata and prefetch likely prefixes. Follow dependencies: licensing and bytes may overlap after resolution, while decoding waits for both. Wrong predictions waste resources without replacing authorization. Budget tails and random jumps rather than only cached medians.

problem.vi: Nhiều small round trips làm từng skip chậm dù server CPU thấp.
problem.en: Small round trips delay skips despite low server CPU.

decision.vi: Bounded client caches/prefetch, dependency-aware concurrency và QoE instrumentation.
decision.en: Use bounded caching/prefetch, dependency-aware concurrency and QoE instrumentation.

tradeoff.vi: Stale metadata/keys, wrong predictions và device constraints tăng variants.
tradeoff.en: Stale state, bad predictions and device constraints add variants.

nextPressure.vi: Offline/mobile cần license và encrypted-download lifecycle rõ.
nextPressure.en: Offline/mobile playback needs explicit license/download lifecycle.

exitCriteria.vi: Cache hit không bypass revoked/expired authorization theo selected contract.
exitCriteria.en: Cache hits respect selected expiry/revocation contracts.

title.vi: Offline bytes và bounded rights capability
title.en: Offline bytes and bounded rights capabilities

description.vi: Download encrypted media cùng manifest/checksums; cấp license/device capability có scope, expiry và check-in policy. Offline client không thể biết instant remote revocation khi không có network; product chấp nhận bounded staleness hoặc yêu cầu reconnect. Hardware/secure storage và clock rollback controls là implementation/security design riêng.
description.en: Download encrypted media with manifests/integrity and scoped device capabilities with expiry/check-in policy. Disconnected clients cannot learn instant revocation; accept bounded staleness or require reconnect. Secure storage and rollback defenses need separate design.

problem.vi: Users mất mạng nhưng vẫn muốn nghe nội dung đã được cấp phép.
problem.en: Users lose networks while needing authorized downloads.

decision.vi: Separate bytes/license state, explicit offline UX và device quotas.
decision.en: Separate media/license state with explicit offline UX and device quotas.

tradeoff.vi: Expired rights, lost device, clock tampering và incomplete downloads cần xử lý.
tradeoff.en: Handle expiry, lost devices, tampered clocks and incomplete downloads.

nextPressure.vi: Nhiều devices cần sync playlist intent và resume state.
nextPressure.en: Multiple devices need synchronized playlists and resume state.

exitCriteria.vi: Offline capability invalid không tự refresh được bằng cached ciphertext.
exitCriteria.en: Invalid offline capabilities cannot refresh through cached ciphertext.

title.vi: Playlist operations, snapshots và stable anchors
title.en: Playlist operations, snapshots and stable anchors

description.vi: Một entry có identity riêng dù track lặp. Device gửi op ID, base version và anchors; authority validate quyền, dedup và rebase/conflict theo protocol. Log chỉ lưu order, không tự hiểu intent. Snapshot/compaction giữ accepted results và tombstone/context tới offline horizon; missing context cần resync.
description.en: Entries have distinct identities even when tracks repeat. Devices send operation identities, base versions and anchors; authority authorizes, deduplicates and rebases/conflicts. Logs alone do not understand intent. Snapshots retain results/context or require resynchronization.

problem.vi: Offline concurrent inserts/moves/removes dễ làm mutable array mất edits.
problem.en: Offline inserts, moves and removals can lose edits in mutable arrays.

decision.vi: Stable entries/anchors và versioned authority log hoặc full sequence CRDT/OT.
decision.en: Use stable entries/anchors with an authority log or complete sequence CRDT/OT.

tradeoff.vi: Conflict semantics, compaction và ACL changes có user-visible cost.
tradeoff.en: Conflicts, compaction and permission changes are visible costs.

nextPressure.vi: Delivery sources thay đổi nhưng playlist/control API nên ổn định.
nextPressure.en: Delivery sources change while control contracts should remain stable.

exitCriteria.vi: Lost reply replay không duplicate entry; stale index không silently move intent.
exitCriteria.en: Retries preserve entries and stale indexes do not silently change intent.

title.vi: Đơn giản hóa delivery bằng CDN/origin

description.vi: Khi peer path không còn đáng complexity, hợp nhất delivery qua edge caches/origin. Retain client cache/prefetch và encrypted-generation integrity. Rights/key path vẫn có scope/expiry; encryption không chứng minh có quyền phân phối mọi bytes ở mọi nơi. Cache TTL/path/query/auth policy phải được kiểm theo license và privacy contract.
description.en: Retire peer complexity when measured benefits no longer justify it, retaining client caches and integrity. Licensing remains scoped; encryption does not authorize unrestricted distribution. Check cache policies against licensing and privacy contracts.

problem.vi: Multiple delivery stacks làm mobile/desktop operations khó hơn lợi ích tiết kiệm.
problem.en: Multiple stacks add more operations than savings justify.

decision.vi: Versioned origin assets, CDN steering/shielding và safe rollout per cohort.
decision.en: Use versioned assets, CDN steering/shielding and cohort rollouts.

tradeoff.vi: Origin egress, misses và concentration/vendor dependency tăng.
tradeoff.en: Origin egress, misses and vendor concentration grow.

nextPressure.vi: Events/analytics scale độc lập audio bytes.
nextPressure.en: Events and analytics scale separately from media bytes.

exitCriteria.vi: Fail edge/origin giữ QoE/fallback bounds; rollout không expose wrong generation.
exitCriteria.en: Failures preserve bounded QoE/fallback and correct generations.

Dual-run endpoints/pipelines, compare accepted identities và output snapshots; mapping offsets/checkpoints khi đổi transport cần explicit protocol, không copy một numeric offset giữa systems.

title.vi: 7. Time to first sound là critical path
title.en: 7. Time to first sound is a critical path

paragraphs.vi: Một naive sum có thể overestimate nếu rights và bytes chạy parallel; ngược lại assumed overlap có thể underestimate nếu key/file ID cần resolve trước. Draw dependency DAG và measure milestones trên client: tap, connection/metadata/license ready, first bytes, decoder ready, audible output. Network RTT, server queue, payload transfer và device decode không cùng một metric.
paragraphs.en: Naive sums overestimate overlap while imaginary concurrency underestimates dependencies. Draw a DAG and instrument taps, connections, metadata/rights, bytes, decoder and output milestones. RTT, server queues, transfer and decoding are distinct measurements.

paragraphs.vi: Fixture default cold2RTT + metadata1RTT + max(license1RTT, chunkRTT+transfer) + decode. At100ms/5Mbps/160kbps, serial584ms và overlap484ms; đây là derived arithmetic, không benchmark. Prefetch đúng chỉ bỏ chunk wait; expired license vẫn fetch. Denied verdict không có first sound. Low-bitrate transition cần compatible decoder/manifest, không hứa listener không bao giờ nhận ra.
paragraphs.en: The fixture uses cold setup, metadata, overlapped licensing/bytes and decode. At100ms RTT and5Mbps, serial is584ms versus484ms parallel: derived arithmetic, not a benchmark. Prefetch removes byte waits, not expired licensing. Denial has no first sound, and low-bitrate transitions require compatibility.

rows.vi: Warm + metadata hit + đúng prefetched bytes; license miss
rows.en: Warm + metadata hit + correct prefetch; license miss

rows.vi: Cùng warm state, valid scoped license cũng hit
rows.en: Same warm state with a valid scoped license hit

rows.vi: 20 ms trong model; không phải SLA
rows.en: 20 ms in the model; not an SLA

rows.vi: Không decode/output dù cache đủ bytes
rows.en: No decoding/output even when media is cached

rows.vi: Không có first sound hợp lệ

caption.vi: RTT 100 ms, payload bandwidth 5 Mbps, prefix 2 s ở 160 kbps = 40 KB decimal → 64 ms transfer, decode 20 ms. Chỉ hai hàng đầu tách riêng tác dụng overlap; các hàng sau cố ý đổi thêm cache/connection state. Không tính radio wake, DNS, queue/jitter hoặc device work khác.
caption.en: RTT 100 ms, 5 Mbps payload bandwidth and a 2 s 160 kbps prefix produce 40 KB decimal and 64 ms transfer, with 20 ms decode. Only the first two rows isolate overlap; later rows deliberately change cache/connection state. Radio wake, DNS, queues/jitter and other device work are excluded.

title.vi: 8. Cache bytes, license và offline clocks
title.en: 8. Cached bytes, licenses and offline clocks

paragraphs.vi: Media cache key cần immutable generation/codec/chunk và integrity; authorization response cache cần principal/device/content/policy/expiry scope khác. Publicly reachable ciphertext vẫn có licensing/privacy/distribution constraints. Encryption không tự là integrity hay erasure; DRM implementation, secure device storage và adversarial threat model nằm ngoài worksheet.
paragraphs.en: Media caches need generation, codec, chunks and integrity; authorization caches have different principal/device/policy/expiry scopes. Ciphertext still has distribution/privacy constraints. Encryption alone establishes neither integrity nor erasure; production DRM/security is outside the worksheet.

paragraphs.vi: Offline capability đặt bounded check-in window và clock rollback handling. Device disconnected không thể nhận instant subscription revoke; chọn fail-closed khi expiry hoặc require reconnect, với UX phù hợp. Partial downloads, content removed, device deauthorization và storage cleanup cần state machines; deleting local index không chứng minh secure deletion mọi bytes/keys.
paragraphs.en: Offline capabilities need bounded check-ins and rollback controls. Disconnected devices cannot instantly learn revocation; expiry may deny or require reconnect. Downloads, content removal, deauthorization and cleanup need explicit lifecycles without overstating secure erasure.

title.vi: Bytes còn trên máy không tự gia hạn quyền nghe

title.vi: 9. Playlist log chỉ là một phần của merge protocol
title.en: 9. Playlist logs are only part of a merge protocol

paragraphs.vi: Lưu (playlist_id, entry_id, track_id, anchor/position, version), operation identity và accepted response. Track có thể lặp nên remove trackID không đủ xác định entry. Server authority có thể serialize/rebase pending ops; collaborative multi-writer cần đầy đủ CRDT/OT và ACL semantics. Một log ordered không tự giữ ý định nếu operations chỉ là stale array indices.
paragraphs.en: Retain entries, tracks, anchors/positions, versions, operation identities and results. Repeated tracks require entry-specific edits. Authority may serialize/rebase; multi-writer collaboration needs a complete merge and permission protocol. Ordered logs do not preserve stale-index intent automatically.

paragraphs.vi: Lab baseA/B/C: deviceA prependX; deviceB insertY sau entryB theo index2 cũ. Index-only có thể đặt Y trướcB; stable anchor giữ vị trí sauB. Nếu Bremoved, tombstone/context giữ logical boundary; nếu context đã prune thì RESYNC_REQUIRED thay đoán. Production concurrent move/delete/cycle cases cần protocol riêng, không suy one-insert fixture thành full CRDT proof.
paragraphs.en: The lab prependsX while an offline insertion uses old index2 afterB. Index-only can placeY beforeB; stable anchors preserve intent. Retained removal context preserves boundaries; pruned anchors require resynchronization. One insertion does not prove a complete move/delete/cycle protocol.

paragraphs.vi: Snapshot compaction giữ base revision, accepted op results và retained anchor/deletion horizon. Offline client quá cũ cần snapshot+rebase/conflict, không blindly replay vào new index. Revoke editor permission phải checked ở commit; pending offline edits không là quyền đã reserved vĩnh viễn.
paragraphs.en: Snapshots retain revisions, results and anchor/deletion horizons. Old clients require snapshot/rebase/conflict handling rather than blind replay. Check current editing rights at commit; pending offline edits do not reserve permission forever.

rows.en: Base [A,B,C]; remote prepends X; use old index2

rows.vi: Index2 trỏ vị trí khác sau prepend; ý định sau B bị đổi.
rows.en: Index2 changes meaning after prepending; the after-B intent is lost.

rows.en: Entry identity preserves the boundary despite rank changes.

caption.en: Preserve operation identity for lost-reply retries; an accepted insertion does not run twice. This deterministic-authority fixture does not prove every move/delete case or a complete sequence CRDT.

paragraphs.vi: Giữ event_id cho transport retry, play/session identity cho semantic counting, raw client time claim và trusted server receipt time. Ingestion acceptance completeness bắt đầu tại defined server boundary; không hứa biết những events device chưa gửi. Client clock/skew/offline authenticity cần validate/flags, không chỉ đổi event-time field rồi tin. Event type/schema version và auth scope có quotas/deletion policy.
paragraphs.en: Retain transport identities, play/session identities, claimed event times and trusted receipt times. Completeness starts at a defined server boundary, not unseen device events. Validate clock/offline authenticity and retain schemas, authorization, quotas and deletion policies.

paragraphs.vi: Progress30s và40s của cùng play có thể là hai distinct events nhưng một qualified play. Unique event ID không ngăn fake sessions hoặc qualification abuse. Rule version, content/territory eligibility, fraud review và report identity cần reproducible. “Raw events giữ vô hạn” không luôn hợp privacy; retain governed evidence đủ theo selected audit/retention contract.
paragraphs.en: Distinct progress events can describe one qualified play. Event identity does not prevent fake sessions or qualification abuse. Reproduce rules, eligibility, fraud review and reports under governed retention rather than claiming unlimited raw-event storage.

paragraphs.vi: Live counts có thể update khi late data; closed financial report cần explicit versioned correction/adjustment và unique effect/result sink, không silently overwrite closed period hoặc pay full recomputation lần nữa. Lateness window không chứng minh future legitimate late events không bao giờ tới; quarantine/pending/correction channels phải declared. Royalty amount không được suy thành một fixed universal per-play fee từ lab counts.
paragraphs.en: Live counts may change, but closed reports need versioned corrections and unique effects rather than silent overwrites or paying recomputations again. Lateness windows do not eliminate all future arrivals. Declare quarantine/review/corrections; lab counts do not establish universal per-play payments.

rows.vi: e1 tới hai lần; e2 là event mới của cùng p1. Unique event không đồng nghĩa new play.
rows.en: e1 arrives twice; e2 is a new event for p1. A new event is not necessarily a new play.

rows.vi: p4 thiếu trusted evidence; p5 claim event day 8 nhưng tới day 2. Flag không là cryptographic proof.
rows.en: p4 lacks trusted evidence; p5 claims day 8 but arrives on day 2. Flags are not cryptographic proof.

rows.vi: p1 và p6 → base 2; p3 → late adjustment 1
rows.en: p1 and p6 → base 2; p3 → late adjustment 1

rows.vi: p2 chỉ 10 s; e2 không cộng p1 lần nữa. Synthetic rule version, không payout rate.
rows.en: p2 is only 10 s; e2 does not count p1 twice. This is a synthetic rule, not a payment rate.

rows.vi: p3 tới day 4: correction có identity hoặc pending review, không silent rewrite base.
rows.en: p3 arrives on day 4: use an identified correction or pending review rather than silently rewrite the base.

caption.vi: Default bật event/play dedup, evidence validation và explicit corrections; threshold 30 s. Transport IDs, play identity, report/rule identity và payment-effect identity cần contracts riêng.
caption.en: Defaults enable event/play deduplication, evidence validation and explicit corrections at 30 s. Transport, play, report/rule and payment-effect identities require distinct contracts.

paragraphs.vi: Generated personal mix dùng một immutable playlist generation từ candidate/model versions đã filter; publish whole list rồi switch pointer để không expose partial jobs. User saves/copies có ownership riêng. Batch schedules cần stagger/quota và deletion/consent propagation; feature lag và popularity feedback phải được đo bằng relevance/diversity/QoE, không chỉ click count.
paragraphs.en: Publish complete immutable generated mixes from filtered versioned candidates/models, with separate ownership for saved copies. Stagger workloads and honor consent/deletion. Evaluate feature lag and popularity loops through relevance, diversity and QoE rather than only clicks.

paragraphs.vi: Hybrid search giữ lexical exact names cùng dense semantic candidates. Query/document models và index version phải tương thích; missing encoder có lexical fallback dưới current availability/rights. ANN approximation/recall và rerank costs trade off. Long-form catalog bổ sung chapters, resume/reset và per-title/purchase/hour-quota policies theo product contract; không hard-code music rules cho mọi item.
paragraphs.en: Hybrid search retains exact names and semantic candidates with compatible model/index versions. Encoder failures may use authorized lexical fallback. Balance approximation and reranking costs. Long-form catalogs add chapters and distinct resume, purchase or quota policies rather than inheriting every music rule.

title.vi: 12. Cloud migration, service catalog và ownership

paragraphs.vi: Migrate transport/data cần accepted event identity/checkpoint mapping, parallel verification và output comparison ở semantic level. New broker offset không phải old broker offset; delivery guarantees/configuration và retention khác cần plan. Backfill không phát lại payout/notification như new traffic. Cloud quotas, regional failure, egress và consumer backlog recovery vẫn là engineering responsibility.
paragraphs.en: Transport migration needs identity/checkpoint mapping and semantic output comparison. Offsets are not interchangeable; retention and guarantees differ. Backfills must not repeat financial/notification effects. Quotas, regional failures, egress and backlog recovery remain engineering responsibilities.

paragraphs.vi: Service catalog theo code-owned metadata giúp tìm owner, API, SLO, dependencies và runbooks. Catalog freshness phải được kiểm cùng deploy/ownership changes; template/plugin permissions và supply-chain checks cần controls. Portal thường không cần trên playback critical path. Org structures evolve; useful principle là accountability và safe paved paths, không copy toàn bộ named team model.
paragraphs.en: Code-owned catalogs make owners, APIs, SLOs, dependencies and runbooks discoverable. Validate freshness and secure templates/plugins. Portals generally need not enter playback paths. Organization patterns evolve; accountability and safe tooling matter more than copying named structures.

title.vi: 13. Failure matrix: audible output và trustworthy state
title.en: 13. Failure matrix: audible output and trustworthy state

paragraphs.vi: Measure TTFS/start failure, rebuffer/skips, license denial reasons, cache/prefetch waste và device power/network cohorts. Tách playlist accepted lag, event server-to-sink latency, missing accepted records, semantic duplicate counts và closed report correction age. Logs giữ safe correlation IDs, không raw keys/tokens hoặc user listening history không giới hạn.
paragraphs.en: Measure startup failures/tails, stalls, denials and prefetch costs by device/network. Separate list sync, accepted-event transport, missing records, semantic duplicates and correction age. Correlate safely without logging raw keys or unlimited histories.

rows.en: Revalidate rights and deny unauthorized output.

rows.vi: Warm bytes, cold/denied rights, offline expiry/clock rollback.
rows.en: Warm bytes with cold/denied rights and rollback/expiry.

rows.vi: Charge waste to budget; normal random-jump path works.
rows.en: Account for waste and preserve random-jump playback.

rows.vi: Commit insert then disconnect/retry same op.
rows.en: Commit then lose replies and retry.

rows.vi: Semantic count once under rule version.
rows.en: Count one semantic play under versioned rules.

rows.vi: Duplicate IDs and fresh progress IDs.
rows.en: Replay duplicate and fresh progress IDs.

rows.vi: Auditable adjustment or pending review; no silent drop.
rows.en: Auditable corrections/review rather than silent loss.

rows.vi: After cutoff replay with same adjustment identity.
rows.en: Replay after cutoffs under stable correction identity.

rows.vi: Reject old owner epoch; preserve retained command result.
rows.en: Reject stale ownership and retain command results.

rows.vi: Old phone seek/pause after new speaker activation.
rows.en: Delay old controls beyond new-speaker activation.

title.vi: 14. Worked questions: rights, intent và evidence
title.en: 14. Worked questions: rights, intent and evidence

paragraphs.vi: Trình bày một Play end-to-end, một offline edit và một delayed event. Chọn latency, sync hoặc report correctness làm deep dive; không dùng generic “CDN+Kafka” làm bằng chứng đã giải requirements.
paragraphs.en: Trace playback, offline edits and delayed events. Deep dive into latency, synchronization or reporting rather than treating product names as solved requirements.

question.vi: Vì sao giảm server latency chưa chắc giảm TTFS nhiều?
question.en: Why might faster servers barely improve startup?

answer.vi: Cold setup, network RTT, license dependencies, payload và device decode có thể dominate. Vẽ critical path và cohort metrics; overlap đúng dependency, cache/prefetch có scope và budget. Không dùng median cachehit che cold random jumps.
answer.en: Setup, RTT, licensing, transfer and decoding may dominate. Map dependencies/cohorts and optimize valid overlap/caches. Cached medians do not represent cold random jumps.

question.vi: Có prefetched encrypted chunk thì bỏ key service được không?
question.en: Can prefetched encrypted chunks bypass licensing?

answer.vi: Chỉ dùng valid scoped capability còn hạn theo selected contract; bytes không grant rights. Expired/denied online verdict không được play nhờ cache. Offline revocation bounded theo check-in/expiry chứ không instant remote knowledge.
answer.en: Only valid scoped capabilities authorize playback. Cached bytes do not override expiry or denial. Offline revocation is bounded by check-ins/expiry rather than instant knowledge.

question.vi: Versioned playlist log tự merge mọi offline move?
question.en: Does a versioned log merge every offline move?

answer.vi: Không. Need stable entry/op IDs, anchors/base context và rebase/conflict hoặc full CRDT/OT rules. Missing compacted anchor cần resync; same track lặp không cùng entry identity. Current editor ACL check tại commit.
answer.en: No. Retain entry/operation identities and contexts with rebase/conflict or full merge rules. Missing anchors need resynchronization, repeated tracks have distinct entries, and commit checks current permissions.

question.vi: Dedup eventID đã đủ đúng stream counts chưa?
question.en: Does event-ID deduplication establish correct play counts?

answer.vi: Không. Hai fresh progress events có thể cùng play; fake evidence có thể IDs khác. Need qualified play identity, rule version, evidence/fraud review và atomic report sink. Lab rules30/45seconds synthetic, không universal payout policy.
answer.en: No. Fresh progress events may describe one play, and forged evidence can use fresh IDs. Qualify semantic plays with versioned rules and evidence. Synthetic thresholds do not establish payout policy.

question.vi: Event-time field từ phone có thể tin hoàn toàn?
question.en: Can phone event times be fully trusted?

answer.vi: Không. Preserve server receipt time, validate skew/offline session/capability và quarantine suspicious data. Define transport SLO từ selected acceptance boundary; không biết event chưa gửi. Business event time khác arrival/report processing time.
answer.en: No. Preserve receipt times and validate claims/offline context. Define transport guarantees from acceptance without claiming knowledge of unsent events. Event, arrival and processing times differ.

question.vi: Late valid play sau report close nên drop?
question.en: Should valid plays arriving after report closure be dropped?

answer.vi: Không mặc định. Retain governed evidence, pending review hoặc explicit correction with report/rule/play identity. Avoid silent closed-period rewrite và duplicate payout khi rerun. Retention/privacy và payout policy được version riêng.
answer.en: Not by default. Govern evidence and use review or identified corrections. Avoid silent rewrites or repaying recomputation. Version retention and financial policy separately.

question.en: Can audiobook resume use maximum position only?

answer.vi: Không nếu user seek backward hoặc restart chapter. Separate deliberate commands và stale progress, current session/device epoch, ordered versions và reset semantics. Cross-device conflict policy là product contract.
answer.en: Not when users seek backward or restart. Distinguish commands from stale progress under session ownership, versions and reset semantics. Define cross-device conflict behavior.

question.vi: Managed Pub/Sub hay cloud làm hết monitoring/ops chưa?
question.en: Do managed transport/cloud remove operations responsibilities?

answer.vi: Không. Provider xử lý selected infrastructure; app còn admission/durability settings, quotas, schemas, identity/dedup, checkpoint/replay, regional failure, privacy và cost. Verify accepted IDs và semantic outputs khi migration, không chỉ throughput.
answer.en: No. Applications retain configurations, quotas, schemas, identity/replay, regional resilience, privacy and costs. Validate identities and semantic output during migration rather than only throughput.
